### CVE-2016-3078
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2016-08-07 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 39742: PHP 7.0.5 - ZipArchive::getFrom* Integer Overflow (remote/php, 2016-04-28, verified=0)

Multiple integer overflows in php_zip.c in the zip extension in PHP before 7.0.6 allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service (heap-based buffer overflow and application crash) or possibly have unspecified other impact via a crafted call to (1) getFromIndex or (2) getFromName in the ZipArchive class.

- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 39645: PHP 5.5.33/7.0.4 - SNMP Format String (remote/multiple, 2016-04-01, verified=0)

- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2016-12-30 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None

- Exploit-DB 42221: PHPMailer < 5.2.20 with Exim MTA - Remote Code Execution (webapps/php, 2017-06-21, verified=0)

The isMail transport in PHPMailer before 5.2.20 might allow remote attackers to pass extra parameters to the mail command and consequently execute arbitrary code by leveraging improper interaction between the escapeshellarg function and internal escaping performed in the mail function in PHP. ### CVE-2016-15031 — PHP-Login POST Parameter class.loginscript.php checkLogin sql injection
- Assigner: VulDB | Published: 2023-05-06 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-89 CWE-89 SQL Injection
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L`
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L`
- CVSS 2.0 (cna): 7.5 None `AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:P/I:P/A:P`

A vulnerability was found in PHP-Login 1.0. It has been declared as critical. This vulnerability affects the function checkLogin of the file login/scripts/class.loginscript.php of the component POST Parameter Handler. The manipulation of the argument myusername leads to sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 2.0 is able to address this issue. The patch is identified as 0083ec652786ddbb81335ea20da590df40035679. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component. VDB-228022 is the identifier assigned to this vulnerability.

Affected:
- n/a / PHP-Login: affected 1.0
